newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cash Converters comes on at 60 cents.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cash Converters comes on at 60 cents.

text.p: Shares in second hand goods franchisor Cash Converters International Ltd made their debut on Wednesday on the Australian Stock Exhange at A$0.60 per share.
The listing is a compliance listing as the company is already listed on the London Stock Exchange.
The company has on issue 144.89 million stapled securities consisting of an ordinary share denominated in Australian dollars and a dividend access share denominated in sterling.
The company has a total of 320 store franchises in 14 countries and expects to open in a further 17 countries by the end of 1997.
By 2.30 p.m. (0330 GMT), Cash Converters shares were at A$0.58 and topping turnover lists with 10 million shares traded.
